title: Front words have logarithmic-space query languages
statement: For all $C,d\in\mathbb N$, define $w(n)$ to be $n$ ones, followed by $0$, then $(C+1)(n+1)^d$ ones, followed by $0$. Both languages of encoded pairs consisting of $1^n$ and the binary representation of an index—one accepting when the indexed bit of $w(n)$ is $1$, the other when the index is less than $|w(n)|$—are decidable in logarithmic space.
